newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shinagawa Fuel bid-only at 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: Shinagawa Fuel bid-only at 1997 high.

text.p: Shares of Shinagawa Fuel Co Ltd, a petroleum products maker, were bid-only at its highest level for this calendar year on Wednesday morning, supported by its plan announced on Friday to buy back up to 4.5 million of its own shares, traders said.
As of 0117 GMT, the share price was bid-only at 740 yen, above its previous high for this calendar year of 710 yen.
The shares were bid-only throughout Tuesday's session and the bids stood at 700 yen at the end of Tuesday. Japanese markets were closed on Monday for a national holiday.
